b: The Order of Ritual Washing of the Hands

One should take a cup and fill it with water, lift it with the right hand, pass it to their left hand and pour the water over the right hand up to the wrist. The cup should then be passed to the left hand and poured over the right. One should then continue to wash the hands twice more passing the cup back and forth so that one has rinsed each hand three times, in an alternating fashion. One should then recite:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָנוּ עַל נְטִילַת יָדָים:
